detaileddescription.para: libbirch is a compile target for probabilistic programming languages that provides low-level support for the fundamental features that may make up such a language. It includes smart pointers and memory management for lazy deep cloning of objects with copy-on-write. This is particularly important for memory efficiency for universal probabilistic programming languages using Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) for inference.
libbirch supports C++ code generated by the compiler for Birch (https://birch-lang.org).
